cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says a law, decree or policy in force classifies government data or requires state data to be held in the country; Camtel's Zamengoe data centre (CMR-001) does not answer that.
cells.note: Reassessed under Bill's ruling of 2026-10-31 (messages-for-bill 60: a rule must include government or state data): the personal data law's local-storage rule (CMR-002) binds any controller, not state data. Camtel's Zamengoe data centre is presented as keeping national data under sovereign control (CMR-003), so stage 2; its hosting of government data (CMR-001) no longer lifts the cell without a rule on state data.
